text-image.looks: A text column (a small label, a large heading, a paragraph and a button) beside a photo, with an optional caption box laid over the photo. Styles: a rounded coloured box (default), photo on the left, or open layouts without a box for long editorial copy or a very large heading.
text-image.use: A mission statement or key message beside a photo, or a longer passage of editorial copy with a photo (variant-2).
text-image.avoid: Several stacked image-and-text rows: Split Card is the site's standard for those.

fields.subhead: Optional small label above the heading, e.g. 'Mission'.
fields.heading: A few words.
fields.bodyText: One paragraph by default; several paragraphs and lists with variant-2.
fields.imageOverlayHeader: Optional short quote or caption shown in a box over the photo.
fields.imageOverlayText: Optional text inside the overlay box.
fields.imageOverlaySubtext: Optional attribution inside the overlay box.
fields.styleVariant: default: text and photo in a rounded coloured box, photo right. image-left: the same with the photo left. variant-2: no box; a section-size heading and room for several paragraphs. variant-3: no box; a very large heading centred beside the photo. variant-4: no box; a wide fixed photo with the text top-aligned.
fields.backgroundColor: The box colour in the default and image-left styles.
